name: Koi Saku Miyako ni Ai no Yakusoku o ~Annaffiare~
original_name: 恋咲く都に愛の約束を ～Annaffiare～
source:
In the near future in Japan, Annaffiare is a theme park located on a giant floating man-made island where dreams come true. There is also a separate ‘city’ on the island where the employees and those related to the theme park reside and go about their lives. Kazuomi was born on Annaffiare and attends a school specializing in management and administration of entertainment facilities. One day, he undergoes on-site training at the theme park and learns about the feelings of the girls, strengthening the bonds between them.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在不远的未来，日本的安纳菲亚尔是一座位于巨大浮空人造岛上的主题公园，在那里梦想可以成真。岛上还有一座独立的“城市”，主题公园的员工及相关人员居住在那里，过着自己的生活。

和臣出生在安纳菲亚尔，就读于一所专门学习娱乐设施管理与运营的学校。一天，他在主题公园接受现场培训，了解女孩们的想法，也因此加深了彼此之间的羁绊。

[来自 [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
